items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: He was playing third saxophone, I was playing first, and Sydney career was playing talent.

ctx.x: When I was playing? Yeah. Yeah. A Sydney career and I can't think of Pierce's last name. Yeah, he's been with Eddie Pierce too. Not the trombone player, I must be. He's a saxophone player.
Is he any kind to Earl Pearson? Earl Pierce, yeah, that's what it is.

But it's Earl Pearson. Now we got it straight. What did he play? He played saxophone. What kind? He was playing third saxophone, I was playing first, and Sydney career was playing talent. So Earl Pearson played alto then?
